notes: Identity independently checked: supplied text identifies the exact title Prefrontal Oscillations during Recall of Conditioned and Extinguished Fear in Humans, Mueller/Panitz/Hermann/Pizzagalli, J Neurosci 34(21):7059–7066 (2014), DOI 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.3427-13.2014. It is a primary empirical article with Abstract, Methods, Results, Discussion, figures, Table 1 and references, not an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_o is assigned; other fields and replication are placeholders. Target ambiguous: description Relationship between AMC theta and fear expression does not distinguish the omnibus interaction F(1,41) = 8.87, p < 0.005 from the direct nonextinguished CS+ versus CS− contrast t(41) = 2.50, p < 0.02, or extinguished contrast t(41) = 1.00, p > 0.3. These are candidate printed test statistics, not extracted target values. Table 1 additionally gives whole-brain AMC peak t(df=41) = 3.72 with **** (p < 0.001), a different regional-peak test. No coefficient or statistic was chosen by numeric matching. No N calculation or effect-size conversion performed.
